raw_segments.text: Good heavens, I thought he was going to begin again," Grushenka exclaimed nervously.
"'Do you hear Midia?' she went on insistently.
"'Don't prance about, but it's nice you've brought the champagne.
I want some myself and I can't bear liqueurs.
And best of all, you've come yourself.
You've come for a spree again, I suppose.
But put your money in your pocket.
Where did you get such a lot?'"
